_provenance.source: US Census Bureau, 2020 Gazetteer Files, ZIP Code Tabulation Areas
_provenance.license: Public domain, US federal government work
_provenance.derivation: ZIP3 centroid is the unweighted mean of the interior points of every ZCTA sharing that three digit prefix. landSqMi is the sum of ZCTA land area. zctaCount is the number of ZCTAs in the prefix.
_provenance.coverage: Contiguous 48 states and DC. Non contiguous states, territories, and military post offices are excluded because ground zone structure does not apply to them.
_provenance.note: Public geography only. No carrier data, no employer data, no order data.
